name: MacGrann's Dried Meats
summary: In Dun Morogh, Old Icebeard has carried off Tundra MacGrann’s winter meat.

sections.title: A Winter Cache
sections.body: Tundra MacGrann hunted game and salted it for the winter. He packed weeks of provisions into a sturdy chest inside a thorium meat locker, to keep scavenging bears and prowling predators from his homestead. Yet he never expected an intruder strong enough to carry away the whole chest.

sections.title: Into the Yeti's Lair
sections.body: Old Icebeard raided MacGrann’s camp while the dwarf tracked deer. The yeti dragged the heavy chest to his den in Chill Breeze Valley. Its solid thorium plating holds, but MacGrann’s injured leg keeps him from making a swift rescue into the cavern. Without help retrieving his cache before winter, the stranded hunter faces starvation in the mountain snows.

faq.answer: Tundra MacGrann salted and preserved a month’s provisions to carry him through winter in Dun Morogh.

faq.q: Why were the meats locked in a chest?
faq.answer: Hungry predators in Dun Morogh, including mountain bears, might tear into the dried meat. MacGrann locked his winter supply in a reinforced thorium meat locker to keep them out.
Old Icebeard stole the whole locker while MacGrann was away hunting deer, then dragged it to his den in Chill Breeze Valley.

faq.q: Why can't Tundra MacGrann get his meats back himself?
faq.answer: His leg is injured, so he can't go into Old Icebeard's cavern and carry the chest out himself.

angles.text: As a cook, you can salt and cure game to preserve meat through Dun Morogh’s freezing cold. Hunters like MacGrann rely on it to keep food for winter.
As a dwarf, you know preparation means survival in the high peaks. Losing a winter cache can mean the difference between life and death.
